verses.raw: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
verses.text: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.

verses.raw: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel [i.e., Gabriel], and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
verses.text: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel [i.e., Gabriel], and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.

verses.raw: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allāh."
verses.text: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allāh."

verses.raw: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy [i.e., son]."
verses.text: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy [i.e., son]."

verses.raw: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
verses.text: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"

verses.raw: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.'"
verses.text: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.'"

verses.raw: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
verses.text: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.

verses.raw: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
verses.text: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."

verses.raw: But he<sup foot_note=255023>1</sup> called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
verses.text: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.

verses.raw: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
verses.text: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.

verses.raw: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'"
verses.text: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'"

verses.raw: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
verses.text: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.

verses.raw: O sister [i.e., descendant] of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
verses.text: O sister [i.e., descendant] of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."

verses.raw: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
verses.text: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"

verses.raw: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allāh. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
verses.text: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allāh. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.

verses.raw: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive
verses.text: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive

verses.raw: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
verses.text: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.

verses.raw: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
verses.text: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."

verses.raw: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
verses.text: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.

verses.raw: It is not [befitting] for Allāh to take a son; exalted is He!<sup foot_note=255026>1</sup> When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.text: It is not [befitting] for Allāh to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.

verses.raw: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
verses.text: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
